products.name: Implement & Manage CIS Benchmarks for Windows 11 Devices for Microsoft Intune — Commercial
products.short_description: Implement and continuously manage CIS Benchmarks for Windows 11 in Microsoft Intune — build the hardened Level 1/Level 2 baseline as Intune policy, prove compliance, and run a documented update process every time CIS publishes a new version. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Harden every Windows 11 device to the CIS Benchmark — and keep it that way as the benchmark evolves

Security and audit teams increasingly require Windows 11 endpoints to meet the CIS Benchmarks, but doing it by hand is brutal: hundreds of settings, Level 1 vs Level 2 decisions, settings that break business apps, and a benchmark that gets revised every few months so your hard-won baseline silently drifts out of compliance. This solution gives you a repeatable way to implement and then continuously manage CIS Benchmarks for Windows 11 in Microsoft Intune — build the hardened baseline as Intune policy, prove compliance, and run a documented update process every time CIS publishes a new version.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — what the CIS Benchmarks are, Level 1 vs Level 2, how the controls map to Intune (settings catalog and imported ADMX) versus the Microsoft security baselines, the compliance/reporting model, and the benchmark-version maintenance lifecycle.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, supported Windows 11 edition, device groups, the official CIS Benchmark/Build Kit source, a pilot group, change control) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide (net-new) — exact, ordered steps: stage the benchmark, build the Level 1 (and optional Level 2) configuration in Intune, handle known break-glass exceptions, assign to a pilot, validate compliance, then expand fleet-wide.
  • Maintenance & Update Guide — a repeatable process for when CIS releases a new benchmark version: obtain the new version, diff it against your live baseline, assess and approve changes, update the Intune policies in a controlled change, re-validate, and record the version you are on.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — CIS-readiness discovery, per-device CIS-compliance validation, a fleet CIS posture and drift report, safe remediation of drifted settings, and a benchmark-version comparison helper that diffs a new CIS export against your current baseline.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Every Windows 11 device hardened to the CIS Benchmark and provably compliant — with a documented update lifecycle that keeps the baseline current each time CIS revises it, instead of silently drifting — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, maintenance & updates, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • CIS11-Compare-BenchmarkVersion.ps1 — diff a NEW CIS benchmark export against the current live baseline
    • CIS11-Discovery.ps1 — tenant/device CIS-Benchmark readiness for Windows 11
    • CIS11-Remediation.ps1 — safely reapply a drifted CIS Win11 baseline by forcing policy re-apply
    • CIS11-Report.ps1 — fleet CIS posture + drift via Microsoft Graph (Intune device config states)
    • CIS11-Validation.ps1 — per-device CIS-compliance check against the expected baseline

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
